review.tagline: Agent skill that generates validated SVG, PNG, GIF and HTML technical diagrams
review.summary: A single Agent Skill for Codex and Claude Code that turns English or Chinese descriptions into SVG diagrams using a Python generator, then exports PNG, GIF motion and offline interactive HTML. It ships 12 visual styles and 14 diagram types (UML plus AI/agent patterns such as RAG and multi-agent), and checks geometry, routing and text fit before output.
review.audience: Codex and Claude Code users who need architecture and UML diagrams from prompts
strengths: Works in both Codex and Claude Code from one skill install
Deterministic validation of routing, crossings, spacing and labels before and after render
Exports SVG, PNG up to 4x, GIF and a single offline HTML file
12 styles and 14 diagram types including the full UML set
weaknesses: GIF animation only accepts SVGs carrying one of twelve approved motion contracts
PNG and GIF export need optional dependencies; Puppeteer path needs Node.js 22.12+
Style 8 (Dark Luxury) is AI-authored rather than generator-backed
README carries sponsor and paid-consulting sections
needs: Needs Python 3.9+, Codex or Claude Code, Node.js 22.12+ (optional, Puppeteer PNG export), cairosvg or rsvg-convert (optional, PNG export)
